0 All You Can Eat Buffet The table is set, now it's time to clear it before it's too late! In All You Can Eat Buffet, each player has a deck of Mood cards, which they play to grab food from the table. During a round, these cards are revealed simultaneously and then resolved in player order and according to their instructions. But beware: if two players play the same Mood card, they must clink glasses and take a drink token. Too many drink tokens might go to your head, and you may no longer be able to decide which card to play! After 10 rounds, the game ends and points are tallied from the different food cards each player has collected. Foods all score differently: meat gives you straightforward points, fruits reward you for collecting the most types, garlic will cost you points unless paired with parsley, and so on... The player with the most points wins! Number of players: 3 - 6 Game duration: 14 mn Complexity: 2 / 5 Play All You Can Eat Buffet and 1414 other games online. No download necessary - play directly from your web browser. With your friends and thousands of players from the whole world. Free. [Rating: 3/10] I feel there's a basis of a good game here for my tastes, but not this. I always love simultaneous turns, but I don't really like when you have to stop to figure out the turn order of resolution and players can make choices during that resolution.  I like the key idea of trying to avoid playing matching cards, but there's no way to really predict what players will play unlike some of my favorites like 6 nimmt, Flamme Rouge, and Following Suit.  And while thematic, it's not fun when a player is no longer playing because they have too much drink.

[Rating: 3/10] Didn't care for this one. Sort of like Guillotine but feels more chaotic, which is hard to believe. It's nearly impossible to develop any strategies.

[Rating: 4/10] This was a dud, at least in my 6p play. Very random and chaotic with no way to tell (or mitigate against) opponents choosing the same card as you in the simultaneous blind selection. Also lots of text on cards that seems unnecessary for what feels like it should be a light set collection party game.

[Rating: 4.8/10] simultaneous selection set collection party game random and chaotic  easy to teach and lots of laugh

[Rating: 5/10] Card game, where you are playing secretly your "mood" which determines what card you might take from row. You are trying set collect specific food cards and score points. It's fine, I just don't think it is very memorable.

[Rating: 6/10] A silly party game about playing cards to eat a certain amount of food.  It is set collection and the set you want to collect depends. There is take that.

[Rating: 6/10] Basically Guillotine with face-down cards so you have less control over the game. Which makes sense that this is a Faidutti design, he does like to have players choose a card and then reveal and resolve (Citadels, Mission Red Planet, Incan Gold, etc).  Nothing wrong with it, and it did make it easy to start playing on BGA without even checking the rules (the set collection this is tied to so basic and standard I was able to figure it out just from iconography).  I just don't really seek these games out anymore. Wouldn't turn down a game of it, though.
